title: Ｗｅｂプログラミング
subtitle: Web Programming
teachers:
HASEGAWA Wataru
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Websites not only show home pages, but also provide a more useful system by hosting applications on the internet that are associated with databases. In this course, students will master the scripting language that enables web programming to be executed on the server side. In addition, by acquiring technologies related to web production, students will develop an awareness of issues related to regional collaboration and future information dissemination to society.
advice:
In this course, students will learn programming for the processes executed on the server side for the purpose of mastering web applications using Apache for the web server and Hypertext Preprocesser 5 (PHP5) for the scripting language. Practice will take place on each student's laptop PC operating in a Windows environment.

Specific class topics include the installation and configuration of the PHP development environment, the basics of PHP grammar, PHP built-in functions, PHP programs on the web, and creating applications using classes and objects in PHP.

Before joining the class, students are requested to enter textbook program examples, practice using them, and understand the contents of the textbook.

Students should note that, because there is insufficient time to explain each legal item and each program in detail, they are expected to read the textbook thoroughly beforehand. In class, lectures will focus extensively on supplementary and advanced textbook explanations.
requiredKnowledge:
Students are expected to understand the contents of the following previous courses: Web Design, Information Technology Basic, Fundamentals of Programming, and Programming.

The ability to write HTML is essential for this course.

Be able to acquire skills that can be used to create web programs at the same level as examples in the textbook.
